formulas.P1: L * P * N; diagnostic coincidence, not conflict of interests
formulas.P2: G * H; recent building increase near protected wetlands, not historical wetland loss

limitations: Hypotheses of interests are untested; indicators do not measure power or benefits.
P1 combines 2026 aforos, 2018 census, and MER 2018-2021; no simultaneous causal inference.
L is a graphic nearest-aforo assignment only within 250m; not observed road flow outside points.
N ranks 11 official noise classes from 0 to 1; not a physical decibel average or legal threshold.
P2 growth is total floor area, not footprint expansion; may include vertical growth or cadastral updates.
Protected legal boundaries are not historic wetland cover or observed water.
Price maps are nominal, not inflation-adjusted, use the same 0-6M COP/m2 legend; not profits.
Legalization dates are administrative dates, not dates of construction or proof of illegality elsewhere.
No historical wetland conversion indicator is calculated: historical georeferencing and validation still required.
